name: ytb2rss
description: Convert YouTube channel IDs, handles, and URLs into feed URLs or OPML without an API key.

scripts.build:portable: mkdir -p dist && bun build ./src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile ./dist/ytb2rss-macos-arm64 && bun build ./src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile ./dist/ytb2rss-linux-x64 && bun build ./src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile ./dist/ytb2rss-linux-arm64
